runtime.backend: llama-cpp-python 0.3.16, official prebuilt Metal wheel from the project's v0.3.16-metal GitHub release (llama_cpp_python-0.3.16-cp312-cp312-macosx_11_0_arm64.whl, sha256 039e1fdef9301c5512c4b4108b4981c39ba54d75bb376b1ea95f9a569ca81228)
runtime.scoring_pass: one forward pass over the chat-template prompt (model's own GGUF template); next-token logits read through llama_get_logits_ith; top 20 tokens
runtime.message_layout: one user message: instruction, blank line, question (amended 2026-10-17 22:25 IST after the pilot showed Mistral's template rejects a system role; applies to all models)

phases.pilot: 15 per domain, disjoint, used only to size the run and set thresholds

scoring: Predicted label = label with the highest summed first-token probability among the top-20 tokens (a token maps to a label when its stripped lower-case text is a prefix of exactly one label). No label in the top 20 = wrong. Accuracy against the dataset label.

timing.per_item: wall time (perf_counter), process CPU time, and wall-clock start/end in epoch seconds
timing.replay: confirmatory cells only: first 10 items of each cell, 3 warm-up passes discarded, then 5 measured repetitions
timing.latency_note: With max_tokens 1, latency is prompt processing plus one decoding step: a time-to-first-token measure.

energy_model.provenance: measured (device and edge tiers, Mac component power)
energy_model.instrument: sudo powermetrics --samplers cpu_power,gpu_power,ane_power -i 200 (text output, started before the idle baseline, stopped after the last cell)
energy_model.idle_baseline: 60 s with no benchmark process, immediately before the first cell; mean combined power P_idle
energy_model.per_request: For each cell, P_cell = mean combined (CPU+GPU+ANE) power over the samples whose window lies inside the cell's main-pass window; J_per_request = (P_cell - P_idle) * main_window_s / n_items. Incremental component energy, apportioned evenly across the cell's requests.
energy_model.sensitivity: repeat with P_idle from the first and last 30 s of the baseline; report the spread
energy_model.excludes: display, memory, SSD, fans and power-supply losses; no wall-plug meter
energy_model.carbon: not converted by default; any gCO2e figure must cite a dated grid-intensity source and show a range

splits.rule: confirmatory items split per domain into train 50%, validation 20%, test 30% with random.Random(20261017)
splits.use: routers fit on train, thresholds tuned on validation, all reported comparisons on test

hypotheses.H3: On held-out test items, the best non-oracle routing policy reduces mean estimated energy per request by at least X percent versus always-largest-local-model (qwen7b-q4, edge) with a mean accuracy loss of no more than Y percentage points.
hypotheses.set_from: Mac pilot, 45 disjoint items, 17 Oct 2026 22:27 IST
hypotheses.rationale: Y = 5 accuracy points is the largest loss we treat as acceptable for an SME replacing its largest local model; X = 25 percent is the smallest saving we treat as worth the routing complexity. Both are practical tolerances, not values tuned to make H3 pass. Pilot observation: always qwen7b-q4 (device) scored 71.1 percent on 45 items at a mean 20.8 J per request; a p_max cascade from qwen1.5b-q4 saved 38 to 80 percent of energy but lost 15.6 to 20.0 points across thresholds 0.5 to 0.95, so H3 may well be rejected.

analysis.ci: 2000 bootstrap resamples over items, seed 20261017, 95 percent percentile
analysis.paired: policies compared on the same test items
analysis.multiple_comparisons: H3 is the single confirmatory test; all other comparisons are descriptive

supersedes: configs/2026-10-17-cloud-v1.json (draft for GitHub runners, never run). The runner probe is reported only as a footnote.

exclusion_rules.swap: a cell whose vm_stat page-outs increase during the cell is excluded from latency and energy analysis (quality is kept)
exclusion_rules.thermal: pmset -g therm recorded before each cell; any CPU speed limit below 100 is reported

pilot.items: 15 per domain (phase=pilot), all configurations and tiers, no timing replay
pilot.outputs: projected total minutes and per-item times; X and Y chosen and recorded in v1.1
